cluster_name: NYGC ALS Consortium Postmortem Brain & Spinal Cord Pool
donor_accounting_and_anti_pseudoreplicat: 1,659 RNA-seq libraries in GSE153960 span 5 CNS regions (Motor, Frontal, Cervical, Lumbar, Thoracic) from shared NYGC donors: all regressions fit strictly WITHIN each CNS region with 1 row per unique ExternalSubjectId (assert_unique_donors) and exclude_pure_ftd=True for motor-ALS subtype rates. Tam 2019 (GSE124439), Humphrey 2023, O'Neill 2025 subtypes, Ma 2022 cryptic validation, and Bryce-Smith 2025 NYGC ALE counts draw from this same NYGC biobank and are treated as multi-modal annotations of one donor pool, never independent participant replications.
canonical_model_formula: HC3 OLS per region: log2(CPM+1) ~ group + RIN + platform + sex + age + gc_z + prop_neuron + prop_glia

cluster_name: MIT / Pineda Primary Motor (BA4) & Prefrontal (BA9) snRNA-seq Cohort
donor_accounting_and_anti_pseudoreplicat: Single nuclei are collapsed to donor-by-lineage pseudobulk prior to regression (never cell-level pseudoreplication); BA4 and BA9 libraries share MIT donors and are analyzed separately per region, while Pineda mmc2 and DS_BA9_BUNDLE represent derived views of the same cohort.
canonical_model_formula: Donor-pseudobulk OLS per lineage/region: log2(CPM+1) ~ diagnosis + sex + pmi + donor_gc_tilt_z (Holm m=14 for BA9; BH-FDR protein-coding for BA4)

donor_accounting_and_anti_pseudoreplicat: 48 cortical snRNA-seq libraries (BA4/BA6/BA9/BA44/BA46) derive from 34 unique donors; expression is aggregated to 1 observation per unique donor within each cellular lineage prior to Welch/OLS testing (noting small n=7 control donor count in rare endothelial lineage).
canonical_model_formula: Donor-collapsed lineage OLS / Welch t: donor_mean_log2CPM ~ diagnosis + gc_shift_z (N<=34 unique donors)

donor_accounting_and_anti_pseudoreplicat: Emory Set 1 TMTpro (N=101) shares n=51 ALS participants with 4-Center Set 2 DIA-MS (N=259: Emory 118, MGH 78, WashU 32, UMilan 31) -> classified as OVERLAPPING_PLATFORM_VALIDATION, not independent cohort replication. Because UMilan (31 ALS / 0 Ctrl) and WashU (26 ALS / 2 Ctrl + 4 asym) lack balanced controls and MGH controls show -0.50z center offset, primary discovery is anchored within Emory (n=96) or center-adjusted OLS, with Oh 2023 (PMC10215566, NEALS/UCSF) serving as independent external CSF cohort.
canonical_model_formula: Within-Emory Welch/OOF-CV & 4-Center OLS: log2_intensity ~ status + center + age + sex (assert_contrast_pair)

cluster_name: Spillman 2026 Subcellular Cortical Fraction DIA & RNA-seq (PXD083082)
donor_accounting_and_anti_pseudoreplicat: Homogenate DIA, Synaptosome (P2) DIA, Insoluble Pellet DIA (MOESM1), bulk RNA-seq (MOESM2), and cryptic junction peptides (MOESM5) derive from the same 10 C9-FTD and 10 Control frontal cortices (never pooled across fractions; assert_modality prevents reporting RNA as protein), distinct from the separate n=3 vs 3 iPSC-neuron oxidative/proteostatic DIA experiment (MOESM3).
canonical_model_formula: Per-fraction two-sided Welch t / exact Fisher (10 C9-FTD vs 10 Ctrl brains; iPSC n=3 vs 3 labeled Level 3 Small-N)

cluster_name: Human Neuronal In Vitro TDP-43 Depletion Series (i3Neurons & SH-SY5Y/iPSC-MN)
donor_accounting_and_anti_pseudoreplicat: Zeng 2025 (3'UTR dPAS) and Bryce-Smith 2025 (PAPA ALE/3'Ext + i3Neuron Ribo-seq) re-analyze overlapping upstream TDP-43-KD RNA-seq series (including Brown 2022 WTC11 i3Neuron clonal replicates, Klim 2019, and Melamed 2019); concordant calls confirm isoform/APA mechanism across algorithms on shared in vitro perturbations rather than independent human cohorts.
canonical_model_formula: LeafCutter/MAJIQ dPSI + DEXSeq/PAPA dPAU + DESeq2 Ribo-seq log2FC with transcriptome-wide BH-FDR

cluster_name: AnswerALS Patient iPSC-MN Screen & Multi-Omic Biobank
donor_accounting_and_anti_pseudoreplicat: In Bye 2025 (DS005_BYE), all 107 compounds are screened at 2.5 uM across the same 15-16 sALS patient iPSC-MN lines (paired within-donor Drug minus DMSO difference + exact Wilcoxon + leave-one-donor-out sensitivity + 107-drug BH-FDR), which also provide baseline sALS vs Ctrl iPSC-MN RNA-seq/LeafCutter splicing and draw from the broader AnswerALS repository profiled in Tsitkov 2026 (N=594).
canonical_model_formula: Paired 1-sample t & exact Wilcoxon on within-donor (Drug - DMSO) survival days (n=15-16 lines, BH-FDR m=107)

cluster_name: Within-Donor Regional Pairing (GSE67196) & Nested Spatial Visium Spots (GSE288365)
donor_accounting_and_anti_pseudoreplicat: Prudencio 2015 (DS014_PRUD, GSE67196) pairs Frontal Cortex and Cerebellum within the same N=15 donors (paired Frontal minus Cerebellar difference). Zhang 2026 (DS031_ZHANG, GSE288365) tests 55-um multicellular Visium spots nested across N=14-18 cervical spinal cord donors: spot-level BH-FDR p-values are explicitly tagged visium_55um_spot with true donor N alongside so spot counts are never misread as independent human subjects.
canonical_model_formula: Paired within-donor OLS (DS014 N=15) & Wilcoxon/MAST spot-level DE nested in N=14-18 donors (DS031 MOESM8)
